title: Conditional Branches and Variables, only "==" operation condition works and only if value is "0"

posts.author: Hugooo
posts.body:
Greetings, I'm trying to make a system where the TP is replaced with a fear gauge that displays certain dialogue in battle depending on the amount of tp the player actor has, the end goal of this system is to have it so that when tp(fear gauge) reaches 100 the enemies get different images (transform into different enemies altogether) as well as tint the screen and change the bgm. I managed the actual switching and the bgm changing working, but I ran into a problem with the triggering the actual event. im using a common event and have stored actor 1's tp as a variable, but when i use the variable in a conditional branch it only works if I use "==" or set the variable value to itself which is 0, Im pretty sure im doing things completely wrong but I dont even know how to begin to get things right.
thanks so much for reading all my rambling, im new to RPG maker MV and am loving it so far, I appreciate any help I can get!

the opposite. "tp" is the name used for it and "Tp" would be undefined.
its only Tp in function names like gainTp per camel case naming convention
@Hugooo
your troop event's span is set to battle. that means itll only ever run once in a fight. even though you set the condition to be every turn, the span will restrict it to the first time the condition is true (i.e. only the first turn before you would have been able to gain any tp). change it to "turn" so that it runs every turn

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Also, you want to use else cases for your conditions.
In your current event, if you have 100 Fear, the event will step through every level you defined, so all 4 text messages will show. I assume, you only want one at a time.
If you don't use else cases and mondify it the other way around (like correctly suggested above), nothing would happen at all, before reaching 100 Fear, which would be incorrect aswell.
